data.gender_notes: Aabidah is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿābida (عابدة), the feminine active participle of ʿabada 'to worship, to serve', from the root ʿ-b-d. Aabidah therefore means “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)”. Arabic feminine active participle ʿābida 'worshipper (f.)'; spelling variant of Aabida.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabidah expresses “Servant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿābida (عابدة), the feminine active participle of ʿabada 'to worship, to serve', from the root ʿ-b-d.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidah total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: Is Aabidah the same name as Aabida?
faq.a: Yes - Aabidah and Aabida are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عابدة, meaning 'female worshipper'. The final -h is a common transliteration choice and does not change the meaning.

faq.q: What does the name Aabidah mean?
faq.a: Aabidah means “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabidah come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabidah?
faq.a: The root of Aabidah is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d).

faq.q: How is Aabidah written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabidah is written عابدة in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabidah a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabidah is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabidah appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabidah is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabidah verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Female worshipper; devout woman; she who worships (God)” is established by Arabic feminine active participle ʿābida 'worshipper (f.)'; spelling variant of Aabida..
